0. FOREWORD
( Part 6 ) ( First Revision > was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards on 22 .Iuly 1987, after the draft finalized by the Methods of Chemical Analysis of Non-Ferrous Metals Sectional Committee had been approved by the Structural and Metals Division Council. in 1967, covered determination of 0.2 IS : 4027, first published copper, lead, tin, manganese, phosphorus, nickel, iron, silicon, alumiWhile reviewing this standard, nium, zinc and antimony in bronzes. the Sectional Committee decided that it is convenient to revise this standard in series of parts which, on publication, supersedes tbe relevant method for determination given in IS : 4027 - 1967*. This part is one of that series and covers the determination of zinc by complexometric The other parts are as follows: ( EDTA ) method. Part 1 Part 2 Part 3 Part 4 Part 5 Determination Determination Determination Determination Determination of copper and lead by electrolytic method of manganese by photometric method of phosphorus by volumetric method of nickel by photometric of tin by iodimetric method method

Methods for chemical analysis of other constituents in bronzes, namely, aluminium, iron, silicon and antimony are under preparation and will be published in subsequent parts of the above series. 0.3 In this revision, limitations of EDTA method zinc in bronzes has been prescribed.

IS : 4027 ( Part 6 ) - 1987 0.4 The methods of analysis prescribed in this standard may primarily serve as referee methods and may also be used by the laboratories for their day-to-day work. Due consideration has been given in the preparation of this standard to the facilities available in the country for such analysis.

0.5 In reporting the results of a test or analysis made in accordance with this standard, if the final value, observed of calculated, shall be rounded off in accordance with 1s :`2 - 1960*.

This solution has a pH of 10. 4.2.11 Eriochrome Black-T Indicator Solution - Dissolve 0.4 g of the sodium salt of eriochrome black-T in 20 ml of ethanol, add 30 ml of tri-ethanolamine and store in polythene dropping bottle. 4.2.12 Standard EDTA Solution ( 0.05 M ) - Dissolve 18'6 g of' the salt in 600 ml of hot water.
